AI consulting from Dave Willemstein costs, per package, a fixed price or a fixed monthly fee agreed upfront, never an open hourly rate. From small to large: the Executive Briefing, then AI Readiness Assessment and AI Strategy Sprint. The exact amount is set out in the proposal before anything starts.

There is no standard price for AI consulting, because the questions vary so much. A leadership team that wants a shared view in one afternoon needs something different from an organization looking for an eighteen-month roadmap. What I can do is translate the most common questions into fixed packages, each with a fixed price or fixed monthly fee agreed upfront.
Within a package, the amount moves with a few concrete factors:
Scope: a single department or process domain is reviewed faster than the whole organization.
Number of people involved: more business units, interviews or participants means more preparation and sessions.
Number of vendors or options: in a selection process, the number of parties to assess sets the size of the work.
Time per month: for an ongoing role, the number of fixed days per month sets the monthly fee.
Source: Dave Willemstein's rates and typical timelines. Updated: October 2026.
OrientExecutive Briefing: one half-day session incl. preparation for leadership or the board
Know where you standAI Readiness Assessment: fixed price, 2-3 weeks
ChooseVendor Review or AI Due Diligence: a well-founded decision
Set directionAI Strategy Sprint: strategy and roadmap
From orientation to sustained execution: the packages connect, but you can start at any one of them.
Every package has a fixed price or fixed monthly fee, agreed upfront. Request a proposal and mention which package it concerns, and you will know where you stand quickly.

A sober review of your organization across strategy, data, technology, people and governance, in 2-3 weeks. You get a readiness score, a gap analysis and a 90-day plan. The price is fixed, including a closing presentation to leadership or the board. For most organizations this is the logical starting point; full details are on the AI Readiness Assessment page.

For organizations that want to move from scattered ideas to a board-ready AI strategy and roadmap. The sprint takes 4-6 weeks. The investment is lower if a Readiness Assessment is already in place, higher for multiple business units. See what the AI Strategy Sprint delivers.

For when you do not need a full-time Head of AI, but do need someone who keeps the AI agenda on track and asks the right questions in steering committees. The investment is a fixed monthly fee across the Advisory, Lead and Lead+ levels (2, 4 or 8 days per month), set out in the proposal. The minimum term is 3 months, after which the role is cancellable monthly. More on this part-time AI leadership role.

A structured selection process with scorecards and a three-year TCO comparison. A Vendor Review has a fixed price agreed upfront, depending on the number of vendors (2 to 4), over a timeline of 3-6 weeks.

A three-hour session in which your leadership team or supervisory board gets a shared, realistic view of AI. Including preparation on your sector, the Executive Briefing has a fixed price. This is the smallest package, and it is fully credited if you start an AI Readiness Assessment within 60 days.

For investors and organizations that need to assess an AI proposition or vendor. An AI Due Diligence takes 2-4 weeks. The investment is lower for a single solution, higher for an entire company. Always under NDA.
Workshops and training get a fixed price per assignment. Preparation, duration and group size set the amount, and you get that on paper before the start.
Not sure which package fits? Compare them side by side on the overview of all services.

An hourly rate rewards the wrong things. It makes more hours more attractive than a faster outcome, and it shifts the conversation to the timesheet instead of the decision you want to make. With a fixed price or fixed monthly fee agreed upfront, you know where you stand before the start, and the collaboration is about the result.
Scoped advisory work, workshops and second opinions also get a fixed price, with no minimum engagement.
Freelance consultant versus agency: the cost difference

An agency or large consultancy has an organization built around the consultant, such as account management and often a mix of senior and junior consultants, and those costs sit in the rate. With me, you always work with the senior you spoke to; there are no juniors on your project. The trade-off is that a one-person practice has less delivery capacity; for that I suggest partners you contract directly, with no margin for me.
Which form fits best depends on your question, not only on the price.
Want to know which package fits your situation? Book a free thirty-minute conversation; at the end you will hear what I would do, even if that means you do not need me.
Independent: no commissions, no partner deals, no margin on implementation partners.

What does an AI consultant cost?+

With me you pay per package: a fixed price or fixed monthly fee agreed upfront, never an open hourly rate. The Executive Briefing is the smallest package, the AI Readiness Assessment and the AI Strategy Sprint follow it in size. Fill in the contact form for a tailored proposal.
Is the price in the proposal final?+
Yes. Every service has a fixed price or fixed monthly fee agreed upfront. The proposal after the intake call sets out the exact amount, before anything starts.
Can I also book a single question or a workshop?+
Yes, for scoped advisory work, workshops and second opinions. You still get a fixed price in the proposal upfront, so the conversation is about the outcome, not the timesheet.
Monthly or per milestone, with a thirty-day payment term. For fixed-price engagements I invoice fifty percent at the start and fifty percent on delivery.
Do I pay extra for implementation partners you suggest?+
Not through me. Partners I suggest are contracted directly by you, and I charge no margin on their rate. My income comes entirely from the advisory work you pay me for.
